claims.quote: We found that random blocks and local window were insufficient in capturing all the context necessary to compete with the performance of BERT.
claims.reason: ARCH contribution (sparse R+W+global attention). Page 4 Table 1 is a building-block comparison of Random, Window, and R+W vs BERT-base at length 512, so a comparison exists. It is not YES: the full mechanism including global tokens is absent from that table, so the claimed element is not isolated with vs without at matched settings.

ARCH claim that global tokens are critical. ITC vs ETC (Table 2) both include global tokens (existing vs added), so that comparison does not remove the element. No matched with-vs-without global-token result is reported; criticality is asserted from theory, not ablated.
